Indian women Scientists, Engineers, and Technologists
Subsistence allowance, accommodation and other benefits

SERB-POWER Mobility (SPM) Grant 2023 is an opportunity offered by the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), Department of Science and Technology (Government of India) to female Indian Scientists, Engineers, and Technologists to build capacity, knowledge and skill enhancement at the global level. The program provides opportunities for candidates to undertake collaborative research and gain exposure to excellent research facilities at the international level. A total of 25 mobility grants will be awarded per year amounting up to USD 250 which will include subsistence allowance, accommodation and other benefits. Selected candidates will also be allowed to visit and research at the leading institutions/universities across the world for 1-3 months.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
be a woman scientist who has an ongoing POWER grant or POWER fellowship of SERB
not exceed the age limit of 57 years
have a letter of support from the overseas host institution along with the application
The selected candidates will receive the following benefits:
A round-trip lowest economy fare for the shortest route for travelling to the selected institutions/universities.
USD 100 per day for the first month (30 days) and USD 75 per day for the remaining research period (up to another 2 months).
USD 75 per day for a maximum period of 3 months.
Selected scientists will receive an allowance equivalent to USD 250 to cover the expenditure of visa fees, medical insurance, domestic travelling, airport transfers and other contingencies.
Endorsement Letter from the Head of Institution
Documents related to technology transfer (if any)
Support letter if there is any tie-up with any Start-up or Industry
Research Plan in prescribed format and size (PDF, up to 10MB)

The selection will be made by the faculties who gained approval for the research plan from overseas institutions. The selection committee will be constituted by the board.
The application for consideration under the SERB-POWER Mobility (SPM) Grant Program can be submitted through the SERB online portal only when the call for proposals is made.
The applicant has to apply through the online portal in the prescribed format.
The maximum duration of the abroad visit is limited to 3 months.

The rules governing the payment of salary, leave, medical, gratuity, GPF and pension etc. of the organization/institution/university to which the fellow belongs would continue to be applicable as per their institutional norms. SERB will bear no liability on any of these.

The candidates selected under this programme should commence their research in an overseas institution within three months from the date of the offer letter, and if not, the offer will automatically stand withdrawn and no correspondence will be entertained thereafter.
Applicant must submit the endorsement letter duly signed by the head of the organization/ institute where the applicant is employed.
The candidate should also submit a letter of approval for the research plan from the host.
A copy of the acceptance letter is needed from the host institution.
